methodology: Full pipeline from original photographs, fixed automatic crops, unchanged classified masks and fresh geometry. Retained MILP routings are source-derived provisional candidates, not reference templates. Resvg validates exported geometry independently. Reported error is against an estimated mask, not published cutting paths.

hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately. Optional retained snapshots reproduce the compute-worker observer; thread startup and message transfer are excluded.

remainingBrowserLatency.cause: The missing edge feature keeps every candidate below full acceptance. The longer browser budget continues all 18 grid/phase refinements despite retaining the better recovered routing.
